pairing_rule: Use matched baseline/candidate assigned workloads with equal verification/risk and precommitted eligible-wake, exposure/censoring and admission/defer/timeout policies. Randomize AB/BA or crossover from the same sealed starting snapshot, reset candidate-sensitive runtime state between arms, preserve external monotonic audit state, report order interaction and intention-to-treat coverage.

denominator_integrity.rule: Both arms must use identical accepted operational-evidence semantics. durable_progress_per_wake numerator may count only immutable evidence-bound operational acceptance receipts, never caller event_id count. Unsupported DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND claims get zero credit. Exact replay is no-op; same evidence under new IDs is lineage duplicate. Malformed-batch, EventKind/EventIdentity, N/R, pressure provenance, exposure/censoring and defer/reject policies must also be common between arms.
denominator_integrity.reject: No positive speed claim may be produced by minted caller-only operational events, duplicate evidence under new IDs, batch abort, malformed-row censoring, N/R failure, awake/window/commit/heartbeat/poll/retry proxies or unequal routing semantics.

selection_bias_control.rule: Use intention-to-treat assigned-workload analysis and report accepted operational evidence root/count, verified closures, defer/reject/timeout, unsupported operational claims, lineage duplicates, malformed-record outcomes, N/R safety outcomes, coverage and assignment-to-closure latency under common failure/censoring semantics.
